common.afterLook: no re-run, no re-tuning, no second look

control.draw: seeded, from U1 codes at the signal session, never the subject

common.costSide: each side, on that side's value; whole shares = floor(parcel / entry price), at least 1
common.entry: open of the session after the signal session
common.exit: open of the session hold sessions after the entry session; time exit, no stop
common.inconclusive: floors not met (no look, nothing read), or a statistic that cannot be computed (look spent)
common.k: base lineages with a history whose holdout entries meet the floors, counted before any price is read; at most 3
common.lowerBound: alpha-quantile (nearest rank) of stationary block-bootstrap replicate means, block = hold
common.null: floors met and the lower bound not above 0
order: count entries and floors for every lineage
one holdout look per lineage, then its variant
common.pass: floors met and the lower bound above 0
common.prices: vendor split-adjusted opens; raw close (adjusted close times the later split factor) for the tier price floor; no dividends

split.holdoutTo: last signal session whose exit open is on file
split.purge: a development setup whose scheduled exit is on or after the first holdout session is dropped
split.unfinished: a setup whose scheduled exit is after the last session of the extract is dropped before the floors

common.statistic: mean excess (net minus mean net of matched controls) after the haircut, in ppm of the entry value
common.universe: tier U1 by the app tier rule over the bars up to and including the signal session
common.volDecile: decile of the sample st. dev. of 60 sessions of daily log returns of the split-adjusted close, at least 54 returns, among U1 codes; 0 is lowest

lineages.detector: close is the highest close of the last 252 sessions (a bar on or before the session 251 earlier is needed) and volume is at least 2 times the median volume of the 20 prior sessions (at least 18 with a bar)
lineages.hypothesis: A close at a new 252-session high on at least twice the usual volume is followed by a positive excess return over matched controls.

lineages.detector: first session of each calendar month; volatility decile 0 among U1 codes
lineages.hypothesis: The lowest-volatility decile of the universe, taken on the first session of each month, earns a positive excess return over matched controls.

lineages.detector: first session on which a report is known (publication date before the session date): short share at least 5 percent and at least 2 percentage points below the latest report known 20 sessions earlier
lineages.hypothesis: A heavily shorted code whose short position has been falling earns a positive excess return over matched controls.

lineages.detector: results announcement whose parsed statement beats the previous period
lineages.history: none: no announcement history and no statement parser
lineages.hypothesis: Results announcements with parsed statements that beat the previous period are followed by a positive excess return.

lineages.detector: announced index inclusion; entry after the notice, exit at the effective date
lineages.hypothesis: Codes announced for index inclusion earn a positive excess return from the session after the notice to the effective date.

lineages.detector: at least 2 director on-market buys in 20 sessions
lineages.hypothesis: Two or more director on-market buys within 20 sessions are followed by a positive excess return.
